mcnemar.assumption: Independent row pairs and equal orientations of discordance under the null.

preferred_group_bootstrap.method: Percentile intervals. Uniformly sample groups with replacement, drawing the original number of groups. Retain all rows and both predictions in each sampled group. Replicate row counts may vary.
preferred_group_bootstrap.estimand: Row-weighted accuracy and fixed-ten-class Macro-F1 differences, conditional on the fitted models.

group_randomization_sensitivity.method: Exact two-sided within-group model-label swap for accuracy
group_randomization_sensitivity.assumption: Joint model labels are exchangeable within independent groups under the null.
